snippet.title: Dungeon Settlers – Early Access Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
A colony sim-based dungeon crawler where you manage expeditions, build a settlement in barren land, provide food and shelter for your people, and lead them deep into a merciless dungeon to overcome challenging combat with strategy.

Early Access launches on September 10, 2026.
Wishlist Now on Steam!
